# Draft:Historical Society of Southern California

California Historical Society Quarterly and HSSC should link here
Historical Society of Southern California (HSSC) is a historical society in Southern California founded in 1883. It publishes Southern California Quarterly as well as a newsletter and books.
Mott Porter wrote in its quarterly publication.
It has a collection of mewspapers.
J. M. Guinn A. M. was Secretary and President of the Historical Society of Southern California
Henry Dwight Barrows was active in it.
Lowell E. Hardy edited the Quarterly in 1943.
